field_meaning.hi: अस्थिर प्रणालियों के लिए नियंत्रण विधि।

review_objections: Google: The Hindi definition describes 'unstable systems' rather than the control of nonlinear systems, which is inaccurate.
NVIDIA: Hindi meaning 'अस्थिर प्रणालियों के लिए नियंत्रण विधि।' is incorrect; nonlinear control applies to nonlinear systems, not exclusively unstable ones.
